xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4944: Agent MCP and bots (W-APPR1): Approvals for every harness and a fleet-wide pending list

plan.title: Agent MCP and bots (W-APPR1): Approvals for every harness and a fleet-wide pending list
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One subsystem (src/lib/mcp approval tools) plus one read route; 11 files total.

narratives.Problem: The dashboard has eight approval routes with approve rows, but the MCP server exposes only answer_question (Claude Code conversations) and answer_permission. MCP clients cannot answer pane menus, Pi asks, Codex approvals, plan approvals or any work agent's prompt, and list_pending_input shows only this machine's conversations: no agents, no linked machines, and no agent permission request ids.
narratives.Proposal: Add GET /api/needs-you (read:conversations): this machine's Needs-You feed with agent rows enriched from the read model (pendingAskUserQuestion, redacted channel permissionRequests), without touching buildNeedsYou(). Rewrite list_pending_input to merge it with GET /api/fleet/needs-you into { machines: [...] } with linked rows renamed @<env>/<name> and linked agents marked remote: true. Add six thin approve-scoped proxy tools in src/lib/mcp/tools-approve.ts (answer_pane_choice, answer_codex_approval, answer_pi_ask, answer_plan, answer_agent_plan, answer_agent_permission) and give answer_question an agentId branch plus Pi/Codex redirect errors. Prove AC-15 with the real-gate mcp-acceptance test and document the tools in configuration/mcp.mdx.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing buildNeedsYou(), services/needs-you-feed.ts, the link heartbeat hash, or GET /api/machines/needs-you.
- An MCP tool for agent pane menus; POST /api/agents/:id/pane-choice keeps no route-scope row (admin only).
- Answering agents on linked machines; tools taking agentId refuse ids starting with @.
- Any route-scope row other than GET /api/needs-you, and any change to an approval route handler.
- The epic W-DOC revision note in .pan/drafts/pan-4649.md.
- Frontend changes.
- A separate tools-approve-agent.ts module.

autoDecisions.summary: Enrich agent rows in the new GET /api/needs-you route, not in buildNeedsYou().
autoDecisions.rationale: buildNeedsYou's hash rides in the link heartbeat and every peer caches its shape; changing it would churn every linked machine's cache for no benefit.

autoDecisions.summary: Agent rows gain pendingAskUserQuestion and permissionRequests (beyond the epic PRD's step 1).
autoDecisions.rationale: Without a requestId, answer_agent_permission is unusable from MCP, and answer_question(agentId) has no question text; the read model already holds both.

autoDecisions.summary: Agents that have a channel permission request but empty pendingInputKinds are added to the feed with permissionRequest.
autoDecisions.rationale: The read model keeps channel requests apart from agent kinds (the frontend checks both), so the feed would otherwise hide answerable prompts.

autoDecisions.summary: Redact inputPreview with redactPermissionInputPreview in the route.
autoDecisions.rationale: Stored previews are raw and MCP output lands in bot and agent transcripts.

autoDecisions.summary: Agent-targeted tools reach this machine only and refuse @-prefixed agent ids; linked agents are listed with remote: true.
autoDecisions.rationale: The linked proxy forwards /api/conversations/@... only; there is no /api/agents/@... path.

autoDecisions.summary: Agent pane menus (sessionResume, rateLimit on work agents) stay out of scope.
autoDecisions.rationale: Their route has no route-scope row and needs admin; widening approve is a separate decision the epic PRD did not make.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep every approval tool in src/lib/mcp/tools-approve.ts (about 380 lines).
autoDecisions.rationale: The epic PRD splits only if needed; the file stays well under the 600-line module rule.

autoDecisions.summary: AC-15 is proven by mcp-acceptance.test.ts through the real gate and route-scope table with stub answer routes; live prompt resolution is the test role's UAT.
autoDecisions.rationale: The route handlers are unchanged and already used by the dashboard; the new code is only the proxy and scope wiring, which the acceptance test exercises end to end.

autoDecisions.summary: list_pending_input changes shape from an array to { machines, fleetError? }.
autoDecisions.rationale: The epic PRD specifies this shape; MCP tools are pre-1.0.

autoDecisions.summary: Group the six thin proxy tools into two xBRIEF items (conversation tools, agent tools) instead of one item per tool.
autoDecisions.rationale: They are mechanically identical edits to one file and its exact-list test, so per-tool items would serialize anyway and only add merge churn; each grouped item keeps five checkable ACs.

items.title: Add GET /api/needs-you with agent question and permission-request ids

expected_outputs: lint completes without errors (including lint:circular and lint:file-size)

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4944.md work item W1 exactly. Create src/dashboard/server/routes/needs-you.ts exporting localNeedsYou(deps), handleLocalNeedsYou(deps) and needsYouRouteLayer (GET /api/needs-you). localNeedsYou awaits deps.build() (buildNeedsYou) and deps.snapshot() (ReadModelService.getSnapshot) in parallel, returns { conversations, agents } without hash; each agent row gains pendingAskUserQuestion from the snapshot agent and permissionRequests [{ requestId, toolName, description, inputPreview: redactPermissionInputPreview(...), createdAt }] from snapshot.channelPermissionRequests grouped by agentId; append 'permissionRequest' to pendingInputKinds when absent; add agents that appear only in channel requests; sort by id. On throw: console.error and 500 { error: 'the Needs-You feed could not be built' }. Register the layer in server.ts next to fleetAwarenessRouteLayer; add the route-scope row (read:conversations) and the no-loss-matrix row from the PRD; append GET /api/needs-you to the read:conversations row in docs/DASHBOARD-AUTH.md line 103. Do not edit services/needs-you-feed.ts.

items.title: Given a feed with one conversation and one agent, when localNeedsYou runs, then it returns { conversations, agents } and the result has no hash key

Given a channel permission request for agent-pan-1 whose inputPreview contains ghp_abc123, when localNeedsYou runs, then agent-pan-1's row returns permissionRequests with requestId and an inputPreview containing [REDACTED], and pendingInputKinds contains 'permissionRequest' exactly once

Given an agent present only in channelPermissionRequests, when localNeedsYou runs, then the agents list includes it with pendingInputKinds ['permissionRequest']; and a snapshot agent's pendingAskUserQuestion is copied onto its row

requiredScopeFor('GET', '/api/needs-you') returns 'read:conversations', the no-loss-matrix and route-scopes tests pass, and a throwing build makes handleLocalNeedsYou answer status 500 with error 'the Needs-You feed could not be built'
git diff shows no change to src/dashboard/server/services/needs-you-feed.ts, and docs/DASHBOARD-AUTH.md's read:conversations row names GET /api/needs-you
Add the four conversation answer tools (pane choice, Codex approval, Pi ask, plan)

narrative.Action: PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4944.md work items W3, W4, W5 and W6 (four mechanically identical thin proxies in one file). In src/lib/mcp/tools-approve.ts add the helpers requiredInteger, conversationPath and CONVERSATION_PROPERTY exactly as in the PRD's 'Shared helpers' block, export PLAN_ACTIONS (copied four values, comment naming conversation-delivery.ts:58-62 and 87; no server import), then add answerPaneChoice (conversation, selectedIndex 0-8, signature -> POST .../pane-choice { selectedIndex, signature }), answerCodexApproval (conversation, optionNumber 1-9, optional toolUseId -> POST .../codex-approval { optionNumber, toolUseId? }), answerPiAsk (conversation, toolUseId, answers of exactly one non-empty string -> POST .../pi-ask-answer { toolUseId, answers }) and answerPlan (conversation, action in PLAN_ACTIONS, optional feedback -> POST .../plan-action { action, feedback? }). All scope approve, audience any, with the PRD's descriptions and error texts. Append them to APPROVE_TOOLS after answerPermission in that order. items.title: Given an approve token, each of the four tools sends exactly one POST to /api/conversations/conv-a/<pane-choice|codex-approval|pi-ask-answer|plan-action> with exactly the PRD body, and answer_codex_approval called without toolUseId sends { optionNumber } with no toolUseId key

When arguments are invalid (selectedIndex 9, missing signature, optionNumber 0, answers ['a','b'] or ['  '], action 'approve'), the tool returns isError true and the fake API records zero calls

tools-approve.test.ts passes with APPROVE_TOOLS names list_pending_input, answer_question, answer_permission, answer_pane_choice, answer_codex_approval, answer_pi_ask, answer_plan, and each new SINGLE_ROUTE_PATHS row passes the scope-equals-route-row check (approve)

Add agent answer tools and the answer_question agentId branch

expected_outputs: the three MCP test files pass

narrative.Action: PRD work items W7, W8 and W9. Export AGENT_ON_LINKED_MACHINE_TEXT and add the agentIdArg helper exactly as in the PRD (refuses agentId starting with @ before any request). Add answerAgentPlan (agentId, action in PLAN_ACTIONS, optional feedback -> POST /api/agents/<id>/plan-action) and answerAgentPermission (agentId, requestId, behavior allow|deny -> POST /api/agents/<id>/permissions/<encoded requestId>/respond { behavior }), appended after answerPlan. In answerQuestion: add agentId and toolUseId properties, required ['answers'], keep the MISSING_APPROVE_TEXT check first, require exactly one of conversation/agentId ('pass exactly one of conversation or agentId'); the agent branch sends { answers, toolUseId? } to POST /api/agents/<id>/answer-question; the conversation branch refuses Pi harnesses (capabilities.askAnswerDelivery === 'pi-ask-modal') with NOT_CLAUDE_CODE_PI_TEXT, Codex (transcriptKind === 'codex-rollout-jsonl') with NOT_CLAUDE_CODE_CODEX_TEXT, else NOT_CLAUDE_CODE_TEXT; export both new constants with the PRD texts. Update the codex test at tools-approve.test.ts lines 63-70, the exact-list test, and add SINGLE_ROUTE_PATHS rows for the two agent tools.

answer_question with agentId agent-pan-1, answers ['Yes'] and toolUseId t1 sends { answers: ['Yes'], toolUseId: 't1' } to /api/agents/agent-pan-1/answer-question; passing both or neither of conversation and agentId returns 'pass exactly one of conversation or agentId' with zero calls

A codex conversation returns NOT_CLAUDE_CODE_CODEX_TEXT, an ohmypi conversation returns NOT_CLAUDE_CODE_PI_TEXT, a 'mystery' harness still returns NOT_CLAUDE_CODE_TEXT, and a Claude Code conversation still receives the composed message (existing test passes)
tools-approve.test.ts passes with the full D-6 order ending answer_agent_plan, answer_agent_permission, and both agent SINGLE_ROUTE_PATHS rows pass the scope check (approve)
Make list_pending_input merge this machine with every linked machine

narrative.Action: PRD W2 (runs after agent-answer-tools because both edit tools-approve.ts and its exact-list test). Rewrite listPendingInput (tools-approve.ts line 44): new description from the PRD; run GET /api/needs-you and GET /api/fleet/needs-you in parallel (catch the fleet request's throw into an Error). Answer jsonResult({ machines: [{ environmentId: null, label: 'this machine', conversations, agents }, ...linked], fleetError? }) where linked conversations get name '@<environmentId>/<name>' and linked agents get id '@<environmentId>/<id>' and remote: true; non-array fields become []. A fleet Error sets fleetError to its message; a fleet non-2xx sets fleetError to 'HTTP <status>: <error>'. Replace the pass-through test at tools-approve.test.ts lines 23-27. In tool-annotations.test.ts remove list_pending_input from SINGLE_ROUTE_PATHS and add a test that its scope equals requiredScopeFor for both GET /api/needs-you and GET /api/fleet/needs-you.
